ensureBudget: exact trusted request/reference -> scoped run/tenant budget; current grant and installed policy before writes
installDeploymentPolicy: trusted deployment operator -> installed reviewed manifest; no caller/JWT attestation
provisionTenantPolicy: current trusted admin grant -> bounded tenant policy, never private runtime authority
resolve: current operation-purpose capability and pinned run -> current policy/qualification only
admit: exact trusted run/request/source -> atomic reserved budget and idempotent child identity
checkpoint: exact current attempt/request/source -> conservative dispatch checkpoint without provider call
markVisible: exact current attempt/source -> current authority and allowed visibility fields
captureTerminalEvidence: exact immutable attempt/dispatch identity -> monotone charge evidence independent of revoked delivery
attachTerminalResult: current attempt/authority/source and retained charge evidence -> private result attachment or withholding
reconcileDeploymentLiability: trusted operator -> bounded exact-attempt charge evidence, never private result delivery
settle: current exact attempt/reference -> idempotent conservative known/uncertain usage settlement
recover: current exact attempt/reference -> retained receipts/no ambiguous replay
releaseNotDispatched: current exact attempt/reference -> release only known undispatched reservation
cancelBudget: current reference/scoped run account -> cancellation retains ambiguous liability
admitFallback: current exact attempt/reference -> allowed explicit non-visible, non-ambiguous fallback reservation
checkFallback: current exact attempt/reference -> safe eligibility only, never embedding-profile change
